rows.job_description:
Job Role: Lead Data Scientist / Lead AI Engineer GenAI & Advanced ML
Location: Mumbai / Pune
Job Type: Full-time
Experience: 5 8 years
About the Role
We are looking for a Lead Data Scientist / Lead AI Engineer with strong leadership experience and deep expertise in AI/ML and Generative AI. This role requires a hands-on technical leader who has built, deployed, and scaled AI/ML systems, including Generative AI solutions, while also leading teams, mentoring engineers, and driving architectural decisions.
The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in machine learning, deep learning, and statistical modeling, along with real-world experience in Generative AI (LLMs, RAG, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, AI agents, etc.). Experience in forecasting, predictive modeling, or advanced analytics should be reflected as part of broader AI/ML problem-solving initiatives.
If you enjoy owning AI strategy end-to-end, leading teams, and building production-grade AI systems, this role is for you.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design, development, and deployment of AI/ML and Generative AI solutions across business use cases.
Architect and implement end-to-end AI systems, including data pipelines, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
Drive Generative AI initiatives, such as:
LLM-based applications
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Prompt engineering and optimization
Fine-tuning and model adaptation
AI agents and orchestration workflows
Apply machine learning and deep learning techniques to solve real-world problems, including forecasting, prediction, optimization, and intelligent automation.
Lead and mentor a team of data scientists and AI engineers, conducting code reviews and ensuring best practices.
Collaborate with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Design and maintain ML pipelines for experimentation, deployment, retraining, and monitoring.
Perform scenario analysis, forecasting, and predictive modeling as part of AI-driven decision support systems.
Ensure AI solutions follow responsible AI principles, scalability, performance, and reliability standards.
Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI, ML, and Generative AI ecosystems.
Qualifications & Skills
5 8 years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI Engineering, with at least 1 2 years in a technical leadership role.
Strong foundation in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Statistical Modeling.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI, including:
LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, etc.)
Prompt engineering and optimization
RAG pipelines and vector databases
Fine-tuning and inference optimization
Experience applying ML to forecasting, predictive analytics, or time-series related problems as part of broader AI systems.
Proficiency in Python, with strong experience using libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow.
Experience with SQL and large-scale data processing.
Strong understanding of ML system design, model evaluation, and performance metrics.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Proven ability to lead teams, manage deliverables, and drive projects end-to-end.
Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)
Experience deploying AI/ML systems on cloud platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure).
Familiarity with MLOps practices (CI/CD, model monitoring, versioning).
Experience with big data technologies such as Spark or Hadoop.
Knowledge of vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.).
Exposure to AI governance, security, and responsible AI frameworks.

Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled GenAI Engineer with strong hands-on experience in building AI agents, orchestrating multi-step workflows, and integrating large language models (LLMs) into production-grade systems. The ideal candidate will have at least 2+ years of experience working with GenAI technologies and frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, with solid understanding of multiple LLM ecosystems including Google Gemini, OpenAI, and AWS Bedrock. The candidate will be responsible for designing, building, evaluating, and optimizing GenAI systems including autonomous agents, RAG pipelines, and custom model deployments while ensuring that the solutions are reliable, safe, and free from unwanted bias or hallucinations.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, and orchestrate AI agents using LangGraph and LangChain to automate complex workflows and decision-making processes.
Build modular agent nodes, tools, memory systems, and workflow orchestration components.
Implement multi-agent collaboration, event-driven flows, and tool-calling capabilities.
Work with multiple LLM providers (Gemini, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock) to integrate models into AI workflows.
Evaluate and select appropriate models based on cost, accuracy, latency, and contextual understanding.
Fine-tune or customize pre-trained foundation models and deploy optimized variants on AWS Bedrock.
Implement and improve Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using vector databases, embeddings, and document loaders.
Build scalable retrieval systems that support structured and unstructured data sources.
Work with MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to integrate external tools and systems into agent execution.
Develop pipelines for testing AI agents including hallucination detection, bias detection and mitigation, evaluation benchmarks, and prompt resilience and stability.
Ensure compliance with internal AI policies, guardrails, and ethical AI guidelines.
Deploy and monitor AI solutions on AWS (Bedrock, Lambda, ECS, S3, Step Functions).
Maintain CI/CD pipelines for continuous validation and safe rollout of agent workflows.
Optimize LLM inference costs through caching, batching, prompt engineering, and routing techniques.
Details
2+ years of experience as a GenAI Engineer, ML Engineer, LLM Developer, or similar role.
Strong hands-on expertise with LangGraph and LangChain for building AI agents or workflows.
Good understanding of LLMs OpenAI, Gemini, AWS Bedrock models (Claude, Titan, etc.).
Practical experience with RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval optimization.
Knowledge of MCP servers and integrating external tools with AI agents.
Experience testing GenAI systems for hallucinations, bias, factual consistency, and output stability.
Prior exposure to tuning or customizing pre-trained LLMs and deploying them on AWS Bedrock.
Knowledge of prompt engineering, tool calling, memory management, and agent architecture.
Solid programming skills in Python.
Nice To Have
Experience with LangSmith or similar LLM evaluation platforms.
Experience in MLOps / GenAI Ops practices.
Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch, Chroma).
Hands-on experience with API development and microservice architectures.
Soft Skills
Problem-solving mindset with strong analytical thinking.
Excellent communication and ability to explain complex AI behavior.
Ability to collaborate across engineering, product, and data teams.
Curious, self-driven, and passionate about AI and automation.
